title: Offscreen | Messaging and cache
description: Repository-owned and read-only. Edit in Git, not in the UI.

options.content:
Freshness rule: a current target is `up == 1` with sample age at most 90s. Missing or stale samples are unknown, never healthy and never zero. `up` is scrape availability only, not backend health.

Redis `redis_up` (backend) is distinct from exporter scrape state. Hit fraction is undefined at zero traffic, not zero percent. Redis command rate includes exporter traffic. RabbitMQ panels are cluster aggregates with no per-queue or per-connection identifiers.

panels.title: Scrape state 1/0 only for a current target
panels.description: Scrape state 1/0 only for a current target; missing or stale unknown.

targets.expr: up{job="redis-exporter"} and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90)

panels.title: Backend 1/0 distinct from scrape state
panels.description: Backend 1/0 distinct from scrape state; missing or stale unknown.

targets.expr: redis_up{job="redis-exporter"} and on(job,instance) (((up{job="redis-exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90))) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(redis_up{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90)

panels.title: Backend used memory
panels.description: Backend used memory; current healthy scrape and backend required.

targets.expr: ((redis_memory_used_bytes{job="redis-exporter"}) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(redis_memory_used_bytes{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90)) and on(job,instance) (((up{job="redis-exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(up{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90)) and on(job,instance) ((redis_up{job="redis-exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - timestamp(redis_up{job="redis-exporter"}) <= 90)))
